EmailTemplate.description: SignZero invitation email. Edit freely, or clone it and set the copy in SignZero Email Templates. Keep the [[...]] placeholders SignZero fills in; see the technical guide.
EmailTemplate.name: SignZero Invitation
EmailTemplate.subject: Action Required: Review & Sign [[DocumentName]]
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello [[SignerName]],
[[CompanyName]] has sent you "[[DocumentName]]" to review and sign.
Open your secure signing session: [[SigningLink]]
This link is personal to you and expires in [[ValidDays]] days. Do not forward it.
